summary: Evogene filed a 6-K disclosing that dissident shareholders L.I.A. Pure Capital Ltd. and Invest Pro Shukai Hon Ltd., following the September 4, 2026 AGM, contested the published voting results and on September 8, 2026 served notice of intent to launch a special tender offer under Section 328 of the Israeli Companies Law (the local analogue of a US proxy contest combined with a tender-offer threat). The company is in discussions to resolve the matter. Separately, directors Yoshinori Oikawa and Yael Margolin resigned September 9, 2026, with no stated disagreement. No price, stake or premium was disclosed. Watch for the special tender's terms, board recommendation and any Israeli court or ISA challenge to the AGM results.
